author: ImNotYourTiger
body: So I was banned by newcleus for trolling, when I wasn't. We were in a scrim against apollo, and I went in gmc and didn't do anything. I just spectated. I didn't even break a single block. Then out of nowhere, newcleus kicked me. It was unfair and i feel like that should be removed.

title: Infraction

replies.author: rinn
replies.body:
Hello,

I will consult Newcleus about this situation, and inform you on his account of the matter, as well as any evidence that can be provided. There is no guarantee that your kick will be deleted, but I will put this appeal under review.

replies.author: Newcleus
replies.body:
Actually, I can prove that you weren't doing anything. Both teams (INCLUDING YOURS) asked you to leave, which you did. After that, you joined again.

You had no reason to be spectating by joining either team in Creative Mode, you could have spectated as a regular spectator. On top of that, your team leader asked you to stop and you still refused.

Here is logs as evidence: https://gyazo.com/d691bf08b4d121110c7afa0e4aa34532
https://gyazo.com/56f4cf0e65edc1985fc2b1020e81c61c
 
Your appeal is denied.
